title: Titans, DT Simmons agree to $105M+ extension

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Titans, DT Simmons agree to $105M+ extension
sources.description: The Titans and defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons have agreed to a 3-year, $105.8M extension, his agents told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.
